title: Paper White 2: a wild encounter area, res/paperwhite2/encounters/areas/<area>.json
description: One area of the wild encounters: the zones whose header names its ENCOUNTERS_* constant (the file's name in upper case) share it. Its encounter rates per method (0 or absent: none there) and the kind of its rustling spots. Its Pokémon are the species files' habitats that name it or its groups. Packed by tools/paperwhite2/encounters.py.

rates.description: The per-step rate of each method, as the original tables gave it: "all_year", or one per season

spots.description: What its rustling spots are: shaking grass, dust clouds or bridge shadows
